proposal: Stop the golf rights map from confidently mis-assigning PGA Tour's HBO Max to golf events it cannot classify. The golf branch in scripts/lib/norwegian-rights.js ended with an unconditional `return [CH.hbomax, CH.eurosport]` catch-all, so ANY golf event that didn't positively match a mapped tour (majors / The Open / US Open / DP World / Ryder Cup) fell through to PGA Tour's channel — and because normalizeStreaming ALWAYS re-derives golf streaming (norwegianRights never returns empty for golf), that catch-all OVERRODE the event's own researched Norwegian streaming. Two failure modes hit real events: (1) a DP World Tour event carrying only its title with no 'DP World Tour' tag in tournament/meta (exactly how an AI-research event is shaped) got its correct Viaplay clobbered to HBO Max; (2) any tour we don't map (LPGA / Ladies European / Solheim Cup) silently defaulted to PGA/HBO Max. Fix: require a positive `/\bpga\b/` match before returning HBO Max (the fetcher stamps meta+tournament 'PGA Tour' on every PGA event, incl. opposite-field like Corales, so the whole fetcher path is unchanged), and DECLINE to guess (return []) for anything unclassifiable — the same guess-no-more principle as the UEFA-qualifier carve-out already in this file (PR #436). normalizeStreaming then keeps the event's own Norwegian streaming instead of overwriting a correct value. Sharpens an existing lib; adds no machinery; touches no protected path.
evidence: visual-qa-log.json (2026-08-13) flagged it directly: 'FedEx St. Jude Championship and Danish Golf Championship both show HBO Max (Sport) ... worth a quick cross-check against the norwegian-rights skill.' FedEx St. Jude is PGA Tour (HBO Max correct), but Danish Golf Championship is a DP World Tour event, which the norwegian-rights skill maps to Viaplay — so HBO Max on that row was wrong.

Reproduced the root cause by exercising normalizeStreaming directly: a DP World event WITH its tour tag ({tournament:'DP World Tour'}) -> Viaplay (correct), but the SAME event carrying only {title:'Danish Golf Championship', streaming:[Viaplay]} (an AI-research shape) -> HBO Max, clobbering its own correct Viaplay. Solheim Cup / AIG Women's Open likewise defaulted to HBO Max.

The norwegian-rights golf section itself documents WHY this class of confident-wrong-default is dangerous: the whole 2026 tiering ('NOT a flat all-golf -> X') exists because the old 'all golf -> Viaplay' catch-all caused the Corales Puntacana revert-war (verify kept amending, the map kept reverting). A catch-all of 'all unknown golf -> HBO Max' is the same bug with a different default channel.

scripts/fetch/golf.js only ever emits tourName 'PGA Tour' or 'DP World Tour' (used as both meta and tournament), so the positive `/\bpga\b/` gate keeps every fetcher-produced PGA event on HBO Max and every DP World event on Viaplay — the fetcher path is byte-unchanged; only unclassifiable/untagged events change behaviour.

npm test: 1376 passed (81 files), up from 1373 — 3 new targeted tests: an untagged DP World event keeps its own Viaplay instead of HBO Max; a non-PGA tour (Solheim Cup / AIG Women's Open) returns [] rather than a guessed PGA channel; and ordinary PGA Tour still resolves to HBO Max when the tour tag is present. All 4 pre-existing golf assertions (Corales/Open/US Open/DP World/Masters/PGA Championship) still pass.
notes: Expected effect: golf events the map can't positively classify (untagged AI-research DP World / LPGA / Ladies European / Solheim) stop being force-shown on HBO Max and keep their researched Norwegian channel; verify no longer has to re-amend a clobbered golf channel.

How we'll know it worked: visual-qa stops flagging a DP World / non-PGA golf event on HBO Max, and events.json golf provenance.streaming notes stop accruing 'RE-SATT' corrections for the DP World / women's tours.

Scope guard: the change only affects golf events whose haystack matches NONE of {masters, pga championship, the open, us open, dp world, ryder cup, pga}. Every fetcher PGA/DP World event carries its tour tag, so the fetcher wholesale mapping (PGA->HBO Max, DP World->Viaplay) is unchanged; the four existing golf tests confirm it.
